closures: No closures in the target zone. Verified live in-session: St. Oberholz (both Mitte locations), Factory Berlin Mitte, THE BARN (Weinbergsweg 1 + Auguststr 58), Distrikt Coffee, Coffee Circle Torstraße.
URL changes noted: THE BARN's old /pages/events-cuppings now 404s — current events pages are /pages/events and /pages/host-an-event (both fetched OK).

Dropped for size/fit, not closures: MARV Specialty Coffee (Mitte, ~30 pax max), House of Small Wonder (reservations-only, no event hire pipeline), Coffee Circle cafés (no reservations at all), Mein Haus am See (bar/club, not coffee type).

Kaffee Burger — Torstraße 58–60, 10119 Berlin. Historic artists' bar once suitable for events; goout.net lists it as 'Venue closed' and its own domain kaffeeburger.de now serves an unrelated WordPress demo page (Brooklyn, NY placeholder content) — treated as closed and excluded.

Factory Berlin legacy events page — https://factory.network/host-an-event now 301-redirects to https://factoryberlin.com/ (rebranded 'Neo Company Builder' site). Event hosting continues via the homepage 'Host Your Event / Request an event' flow; only the fetched factoryberlin.com is output as the link.

Soho House Berlin screening-room-only note: the 120-person Screening Room was not listed among rentable capacities in the fetched event-spaces page sections I captured (Politbüro/Club Room/Red Room/Torstrasse I+II confirmed rentable); no closure implied — flagged only so capacities above are the published ones.

Spacebase listing 'The Chamber of Congress St. Oberholz Rosenthaler Platz' — third-party listing page states 'this space is no longer available'; the underlying St. Oberholz Café Rosenthaler venue is live and listed with its own dedicated events page, so the listing (not the venue) was dropped.

Hallesches Haus (Tempelhofer Ufer 1, 10961 Berlin): general store and on-site cafe permanently closed per the venue's own Instagram announcement ('Today we're saying goodbye to our cafe and store'); now operates only as an events venue and online shop, so it fails the 'coffee' type despite the great Kreuzberg location. Re-opened March 2026 as 1000 sqm event-space-only; no live cafe to anchor a coffee/hack day.

Bonanza Coffee Roasters (Adalbertstr. 70, 10999 Berlin): beloved Kreuzberg roastery-café, but no dedicated events page and no published events/hire email — only generic wholesale/online-shop contact, so excluded to avoid a dead-end booking path.
Chapter One Coffee Berlin (Mittenwalder Str. 30, 10961 Berlin): excellent Kreuzberg specialty café but very small footprint with no published group/event offer; would not realistically host 50-200.

Five Elephant Kreuzberg (Reichenberger Str. 101, 10999 Berlin): specialty café and roastery with strong local pull, but no published events page or hire capacity; site is café-first and does not market private hire.

Techspace Kreuzberg — The Annex (Lobeckstraße 36-40, 10969 Berlin): on-brief address and 100-person capacity, but the venue is a coworking/event product, not a coffee venue — excluded to keep the list on-type for 'coffee'.

Factory Berlin, Görlitzer Park campus (Lohmühlenstraße 65, Kreuzberg) — closed Feb 2024 as part of Factory's scale-down; the remaining Berlin venue is at Rheinsberger Str. 76/77 in Mitte, outside this neighborhood brief (factory.network/host-an-event fetched; closure via coworkingeurope.net search snippet)
Haubentaucher (Revaler Str. 99) rebranded to MAAYA Berlin in July 2024 — pool-and-events concept still operates on the same site, but the Haubentaucher name/pages are stale.
Silo Coffee (Gabriel-Max-Str. 4) explicitly does not take reservations or private hire — dropped as candidate despite strong specialty-coffee identity.
St. Oberholz — original Rosenthaler Platz and Zehdenicker Str cafés are in Mitte, not the target Friedrichshain/Warschauer neighborhood; their event rooms are 50-pax max anyway.
betahaus and Factory Berlin are in Kreuzberg (Rudi-Dutschke-Str / Lohmühlenstr) — outside the Warschauer/RAW area; not reported as candidates.
Badehaus, Cassiopeia, Astra Kulturhaus on RAW are nightlife/concert clubs without daytime coffee/hack-day format; not chosen as 'coffee' type matches.

Griessmühle (RAW-Gelände, Revaler Str. 99) — closed January 2020 after lease termination; the team reopened as Revier Südost / RSO.BERLIN in Niederschöneweide (Schneller Str. 137), well outside the Friedrichshain corridor. Do not book 'at RAW'.
Kosmonaut (RAW-Gelände) — permanently closed; its hall slot is now filled by other tenants on the site.
Astra Kulturhaus (Revaler Str. 99) — NOT closed, still programming through 2026, but excluded: 1,500-person standing concert club, wrong shape and daytime availability for a coffee/hack day.

neighborhoods.name: Mitte — Rosenthaler Platz / Torstraße / Bernauer Str (incl. Factory Berlin Mitte at Rheinsberger Str 76/77 and the Wedding-border edge)
neighborhoods.rationale: This is where the actual AI/builder events ran in 2025: AI Tinkerers hosted 'Come build with us' at St. Oberholz Rosenthaler Platz on Nov 29 2025 (10AM-8PM co-working/hack format, Anthropic + Heartcore + Langdock sponsored), and Factory Berlin Mitte at Rheinsberger Str 76/77 hosted the Factory Network x {Tech:Berlin} AI Hackathon (Sep 28-29, 50-100 curated builders - same size band as the target). PyData Berlin 2025 also ran Sep 1-3 in Mitte. St. Oberholz is the canonical bilingual EN/DE freelancer-developer cafe and is already wired for 50-200 person events.
avoid_too: Merantix AI Campus (Max-Urich-Str 3, 13355 Wedding) - it is the highest-signal AI event venue in Berlin (AI Tinkerers Aug 13 + Nov 12 2025, Briink/CDP, 300+ events/yr) but it's a closed 6,000m2 private campus, requires partnership with Merantix to book, and sits in a cafe-poor industrial pocket of Gesundbrunnen/Wedding with no walkable event-capable cafes around it
Potsdamer Platz / Ritz-Carlton - explicitly the 'too corporate' alternative (Agentic AI Summit 2026 is there); zero cafe-hack vibe
WeWork/Mindspace tier in Mitte - bookable but corporate and identity-less

neighborhoods.name: Kreuzberg — Moritzplatz / Kottbusser Tor / Oranienstraße (betahaus Moritzplatz + betahaus Kreuzberg HQ + St. Oberholz Oranienstr 10-11)
neighborhoods.rationale: This is where the recurring bilingual community meetups actually live: the monthly Berlin AI Meetup runs at betahaus Moritzplatz (Lobeckstr 30, 2nd floor), Silicon Allee's monthly meetup has run since 2011 at St. Oberholz Cafe Oranienstr 10-11 (it is Berlin's longest-running international startup meetup, free coffee morning format - directly equivalent to CreativeMornings/Cursor Cafe), and betahaus Kreuzberg HQ (Rudi-Dutschke-Str 23) hosts betabreakfast weekly. AI Tinkerers April 1 2025 ran at Forto (Kreuzberg-side). betahaus Moritzplatz has explicit 50-200 person event spaces and an external events team.
avoid_too: Factory Berlin Görlitzer Park - closed April 2024 (lease not renewed, per Sifted); do not plan around it
C-base (Rungestr 20) is technically in this orbit but is a members-run hackerspace, notoriously hard to book externally, cramped above ~80 people and not cafe-friendly
Kreuzkölln / Neukölln proper (Rollberg, Impact Hub) - real community energy but no venue that comfortably fits 150-200 with coffee service

neighborhoods.name: Friedrichshain — Warschauer Str / Revaler Str / RAW-Gelände (Thoughtworks Berlin, Revaler Str 31)
neighborhoods.rationale: This is where the large recurring bilingual dev meetups actually happened in 2025 with the highest RSVP counts: AICamp's monthly Berlin AI Meetup ran at Thoughtworks Revaler Str 31 with 170 RSVPs (Feb 13 2025), 185 RSVPs (Aug 14 2025 'Data Systems for AI Agents and Claude Code'), 188 RSVPs (Apr 2024) - i.e. consistently the biggest dev-room in the city, run bilingually EN/DE with international speakers (Firebolt, Anthropic Claude Code, Ines Montani/spaCy). The RAW/Revaler cluster has the post-meetup bar/cafe infrastructure (Suicide Circus, Michelberger nearby) that a Sep tech-week crowd actually uses.
avoid_too: Thoughtworks itself is the anchor but is a single company's event floor - you need a sponsor relationship; the *neighborhood* is the right call, not the building
East Side Mall / Mercedes-Platz corporate event spaces - too corporate, wrong crowd
Warschauer Str club venues (Matrix etc.) - 200+ capacity but no coffee/hack-day infrastructure, sound/lighting rigs instead of WiFi+power
